a cache directory option retired at with-simple-cache `0.17.3`: `directoryToPersistTo` or `s3`.

`directory` replaces both, and each cache `get()` now returns a Promise. the right `directory` shape
depends on where the repo persists its cache, so the fix stamps a `// @declapract:review:` line above
each retired option and rewrites no code. the check stays red until a human moves the option.
